learnings: Created FavoriteButton.razor under Components/DataDisplay/. It accepts a DeckInfo parameter, injects FavoritesProvider, checks IsFavoriteAsync on init, and toggles AddFavoriteAsync/RemoveFavoriteAsync on click while flipping the local _isFavorite bool and calling StateHasChanged().

Updated MoxfieldScraping.razor: injected FavoritesProvider, added an empty non-sortable GridHeader for the favorites column, and added a <td> with <FavoriteButton Deck='@context'/> in the GridRowTemplate.
